name: SwitchLinc Relay Countdown Timer
description: The SwitchLinc relay with a countdown timer that turns its load off after a set time.

operatingFlags.name: programmingLock
operatingFlags.description: Linking and programming from the device itself are locked out.

operatingFlags.name: ledOnTransmit
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when the device sends an Insteon message.

operatingFlags.name: timerOff
operatingFlags.description: The countdown timer is off, and the switch works as an ordinary switch.

operatingFlags.name: noLocalWarning
operatingFlags.description: The switch gives no local warning before its countdown ends.

readings.name: databaseDelta
readings.description: A count that goes up whenever the ALL-Link database changes.

values.name: defaultOnTime
values.description: How long, in minutes, a single press keeps the load on.

values.name: x10HouseCode
values.description: The X10 house code, or 0x20 for no X10 address.

values.name: signalToNoiseLastFailure
values.description: The signal-to-noise value of the last failure.

writes.name: onTime
writes.description: Sets the countdown's hours (D3) and minutes (D4).

writes.name: defaultOnTime
writes.description: Sets how long, in minutes from 0x01 to 0xFF, a single press keeps the load on. 0x00 leaves it unchanged.

notes: Insteon's documents call the local warning 1 minute in the Set Operating Flags table and 2 minutes in the Get Operating Flags table.
